name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Generalist | Growth & Marketing Operations

Built 20+ lifecycle workflows and an automated prospect audit enrolling 180+ contacts; at Wix, supported an e-commerce segment that increased website traffic 30% and conversion rates 25%. Translate performance data into tailored campaigns across paid media, SEO, email, content, landing pages, and CRM, aligning revenue, operations, and delivery stakeholders around measurable lead-generation and conversion goals.
